question: 查询至少续借过1次且所有图书都已归还的读者姓名
gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT r.name FROM readers r JOIN borrow_records br ON r.reader_id = br.reader_id WHERE br.renew_count > 0 AND r.reader_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT reader_id FROM borrow_records WHERE return_date IS NULL)
pred_sql: WITH qualified_readers AS (SELECT DISTINCT r.reader_id FROM borrow_records b JOIN readers r ON b.reader_id = r.reader_id WHERE b.renew_count >= 1 AND b.return_date IS NOT NULL GROUP BY r.reader_id HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN b.return_date IS NULL THEN 1 END) = 0) SELECT r.name FROM readers r WHERE r.reader_id IN (SELECT reader_id FROM qualified_readers)

question: 统计每个楼层的图书零借阅率
